handback.summary: A refused model key now ends the run as Model key rejected; the setup audit tries each set key.

criteria.907.1: Each adapter reads its own error; `agents.rejected_key` matches a refusal and the record step marks the run Model key rejected.
criteria.907.2: The record names the secret `agents.adapter` reads from the settings for that role.
criteria.907.3: `rejected_key_line` says the provider refused the key: make a new one and replace the repo secret.
criteria.907.4: The card shows only the fixed line, never the provider's words, so no key part is printed.
criteria.907.5: `audit.compare_keys` tries each set key once via `agents.try_key`; `audit.yml` installs the agents first.
criteria.907.6: A refused key adds one audit line naming only its secret.
criteria.907.7: A key with no `DOKIMA_KEY_<name>` value is skipped; no agent starts.
criteria.907.8: `entry.yml` passes the three keys to the audit; `audit.yml` declares them and sets `DOKIMA_KEY_<name>`.
criteria.907.9: Audit lines hold only secret names; the agent's own error output is silenced during the try.

raises.label: Tests conflict
raises.text: Test 907.8 makes the audit read the Codex and Kimi keys, so an older test fails unless the install file maps them, which is outside scope.
raises.evidence: `tests/test_secrets_by_name.py::test_install_maps_every_secret_by_name` fails: `dokima/install/dokima.yml` lacks `CODEX_API_KEY`, `KIMI_API_KEY`; passes on main. See #930.
